scope: Operations exposed by historical/current maintained UI and their supporting services; helper functions and presentation controls are not counted as separate operations.
complete_rule: Frontend action reachable without Streamlit, canonical HTTP/domain operation, equivalent validation, persistence/error checks and existing behavior proof; partial/unverified/absent never enter numerator.
counting: One row per user capability; variants of the same control are grouped. Cornell and CPI counted separately because their persisted contracts differ. Controls/functions counts are supporting evidence, not denominator. No operation retired.
